workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad. I've read Priya Raman and Marcus Hale's calendars. Here are the times when both of them are free for a 30-minute meeting:

- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Could you please check Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots (or any other slots) work for both of them? I need to find a time all four partners are free.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison. I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars. Unfortunately, after carefully comparing their availability with the slots you provided for Priya and Marcus, there is NO overlapping time when all four partners are free for 30 minutes.

Here's my analysis of each slot you provided:

- Monday 9:00-10:00: Elena is busy 09:00-09:30 and 09:30-10:00 (entire slot busy)
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Elena is busy 13:00-13:30 and 13:30-14:00 (entire slot busy)
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Elena is busy 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: David is busy 15:00-15:30 and 15:30-16:00 (entire slot busy)
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena is busy 10:00-10:30 (Hiring panel)
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Elena is busy 11:00-11:30 and 11:30-12:00 (entire slot busy)

None of the slots when Priya and Marcus are both free also have Elena and David available. This means there is no feasible 30-minute meeting time for all four partners next week.

I recommend we report this as infeasible. Please confirm if you agree.
